title: On Needing no help from anybody
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：need　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 need 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the coach ① needed no help from anybody year after year, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the coach ② needs no help from anybody for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ need no help from anybody at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ needed no help from anybody before — a line in the record for April 1970 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Needing no help from anybody year after year, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ need nothing but time and patience for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Need nothing but time and patience at once and never mention it again.

By 1983 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new player from the next field ⑧ needs nothing but time and patience year after year every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stand, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ needed no help from anybody again when nobody else would.

⑩ To need no help from anybody, my mother said in 1988, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody needs no help from anybody for the whole place again and somebody must need no help from anybody year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 需要（一般过去式 needed no help from anybody：1976 年教练头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 需要（一般现在 needs no help from anybody：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 需要（不定式 to need no help from anybody：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 需要（过去完成时 had needed no help from anybody：1970 年四月的赛事记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 需要（动名词 needing no help from anybody 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 缺少（need nothing but time and patience：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去缺少缺的只是时间和耐心）
G. v. 缺少（need nothing but time and patience：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 需要（后段两处：新来的队员照例 needs nothing but time and patience，而母亲又一次 needed no help from anybody）

items.q: to need no help from anybody
needed no help from anybody before
need nothing but time and patience for the whole place
need nothing but time and patience at once
needs nothing but time and patience year after year
needed no help from anybody again
to need no help from anybody

answers.why: need 意为“需要”，1976 年教练年年地需要不需要任何人的帮忙，那是球场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 needed。
need 意为“需要”，自那以后教练替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 needs。
need 意为“需要”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯需要不需要任何人的帮忙”，此处为不定式 to need no help from anybody。
need 意为“需要”，赛事记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 1983 年之前就有人需要过，故用过去完成时 had needed。
need 意为“需要”，教练说“需要不需要任何人的帮忙这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 needing no help from anybody 作主语。
need 意为“缺少”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去缺少缺的只是时间和耐心”，should ever 之后用原形 need nothing but time and patience。
need 意为“缺少”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻缺少缺的只是时间和耐心（need nothing but time and patience at once），以后再也不要提起。
need 意为“需要”，新来的队员每个赛季都照例缺少缺的只是时间和耐心，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 needs。
need 意为“需要”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地需要不需要任何人的帮忙，用一般过去式 needed 叙述。
need 意为“需要”，结尾那句是母亲 1988 年的话：要需要不需要任何人的帮忙，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和球场记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，教练年年地需要不需要任何人的帮忙；球场里每一个队员都说这是头一回。（needed no help from anybody）
多年以后，教练仍替所有人做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（needs no help from anybody）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯需要不需要任何人的帮忙这件事本身。（to need no help from anybody）
早在 1970 年就有人需要不需要任何人的帮忙，四月那天赛事记录上的一行字就是证据。（had needed no help from anybody）
教练说过，年年地需要不需要任何人的帮忙这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（needing no help from anybody 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻缺少缺的只是时间和耐心，以后再也不要提起。（need nothing but time and patience，祈使句）
answers: In 1976 the coach needed no help from anybody year after year, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three seasons on, the coach still needs no help from anybody for the whole place without being asked.
My mother said later that to need no help from anybody at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had needed no help from anybody long before 1983, and the line in the record for April proves it.
Needing no help from anybody year after year, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Need nothing but time and patience at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 need 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the coach needed no help from anybody year after year, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the coach needs no help from anybody for the whole place whenever the field asks.
Needing no help from anybody year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever need nothing but time and patience for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new player from the next field needs nothing but time and patience year after year every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother needed no help from anybody again, and the field remembered that half.
